children: Overview
UK intelligent transport systems provider's H1 revenue rose 53% yr/yr to £37.6 mln
Adjusted profit before tax grew 10% to £3.0 mln for the half-year
Diluted EPS increased 9% to 13.60p in H1 2026
Cash balance declined after £10.7 mln acquisition of Crime and Fire Defence Systems
Outlook
Journeo says it is on track to deliver full-year results in line with market expectations
Company expects improved H2 performance from Integrated Services and Information Systems
Journeo says sales opportunity pipeline has increased to £200 mln entering H2
Result Drivers
ACQUISITIONS - Revenue growth was driven in part by the acquisition of Crime and Fire Defence Systems, which contributed to the new Infrastructure Protection segment
GOVERNMENT INVESTMENT - Information Systems growth was supported by government funding for transport infrastructure projects and new contracts from local authorities
SUPPLY CHAIN AND SALES MIX - Integrated Services revenue fell 2% due to delays in new bus orders and supply chain challenges, with revenue deferred to H2
